fields.label: GitLab host
fields.description: Bare hostname only — no scheme, no path, no trailing slash. Use "gitlab.com" for GitLab SaaS, or your self-managed instance's canonical hostname, e.g. "gitlab.acme.example".

fields.label: Personal access token
fields.description: A GitLab personal, project, or group access token with the api scope. Create one from GitLab under Preferences -> Access tokens.

healthcheck.title: Healthcheck
healthcheck.description: Verify the personal access token (or OAuth token) by calling GET /user, which returns the authenticated user's own details. Takes no input; a 401 means the token is bad or expired.

issues.create.title: Create Issue
issues.create.description: Create an issue in a project. projectId is the numeric project id, or the namespace/project path (e.g. "diaspora/diaspora") passed raw — it is percent-encoded for you automatically. The response's id is the instance-global identifier; iid is the project-scoped number every other issue endpoint takes in its path, and webUrl is the browsable link.

projectId.description: Numeric project id, or the namespace/project path (e.g. "mygroup/myproject") — pass it raw; it is encoded for you.

assigneeId.description: User id to assign the issue to.

assigneeIds.description: User ids to assign the issue to.

epicId.description: Epic id to attach the issue to.

issues.update.title: Update Issue
issues.update.description: Update an issue by its project-scoped issueIid (not its global id). Omitted fields are left unchanged. Use stateEvent "close" or "reopen" to change state.

projectId.description: Numeric project id, or the namespace/project path (e.g. "mygroup/myproject") — pass it raw; it is encoded for you.

issueIid.description: Project-scoped issue iid (not the global id).

assigneeIds.description: Replacement list of assignee user ids.

issues.get.title: Get Issue
issues.get.description: Fetch a single issue by its project-scoped issueIid (not its global id).

projectId.description: Numeric project id, or the namespace/project path (e.g. "mygroup/myproject") — pass it raw; it is encoded for you.

issueIid.description: Project-scoped issue iid (not the global id).

issues.list.title: List Issues
issues.list.description: List the issues in a project. Uses GitLab's offset pagination: pass page and perPage (max 100). The response carries no cursor in its body — the next page number comes back in the x-next-page response header and is mapped to nextPage here, empty once the last page is reached. GitLab also offers keyset pagination via a Link response header, but the declarative engine cannot parse a Link header, so this operation uses the offset form only.

projectId.description: Numeric project id, or the namespace/project path (e.g. "mygroup/myproject") — pass it raw; it is encoded for you.

labels.description: Comma-separated label names to filter by.

perPage.description: Results per page, up to 100. Defaults to 20.

issues.comment.title: Comment on Issue
issues.comment.description: Add a comment (note) to an issue, addressed by its project-scoped issueIid. body is limited to 1,000,000 characters. The response note carries no web_url field — a link anchor of the form "<issue web_url>#note_<id>" is a UI convention, not a documented API guarantee, so it is not fabricated here.

projectId.description: Numeric project id, or the namespace/project path (e.g. "mygroup/myproject") — pass it raw; it is encoded for you.

issueIid.description: Project-scoped issue iid (not the global id).

internal.description: Mark the note internal (visible only to members).

mergeRequests.create.title: Create Merge Request
mergeRequests.create.description: Open a merge request from sourceBranch into targetBranch. The response's id is the instance-global identifier; iid is the project-scoped number every other merge request endpoint takes in its path, and webUrl is the browsable link.

projectId.description: Numeric project id, or the namespace/project path (e.g. "mygroup/myproject") — pass it raw; it is encoded for you.

assigneeId.description: User id to assign the merge request to.

reviewerIds.description: User ids to request review from.

removeSourceBranch.description: Delete the source branch once merged.

mergeRequests.update.title: Update Merge Request
mergeRequests.update.description: Update a merge request by its project-scoped mergeRequestIid (not its global id). Omitted fields are left unchanged. Use stateEvent "close" or "reopen" to change state.

projectId.description: Numeric project id, or the namespace/project path (e.g. "mygroup/myproject") — pass it raw; it is encoded for you.

mergeRequestIid.description: Project-scoped merge request iid (not the global id).

stateEvent.description: Close or reopen the merge request.

assigneeIds.description: Replacement list of assignee user ids.

reviewerIds.description: Replacement list of reviewer user ids.

removeSourceBranch.description: Delete the source branch once merged.

mergeRequests.get.title: Get Merge Request
mergeRequests.get.description: Fetch a single merge request by its project-scoped mergeRequestIid (not its global id).

projectId.description: Numeric project id, or the namespace/project path (e.g. "mygroup/myproject") — pass it raw; it is encoded for you.

mergeRequestIid.description: Project-scoped merge request iid (not the global id).

mergeRequests.list.title: List Merge Requests
mergeRequests.list.description: List the merge requests in a project. Uses GitLab's offset pagination: pass page and perPage (max 100). The response carries no cursor in its body — the next page number comes back in the x-next-page response header and is mapped to nextPage here, empty once the last page is reached. GitLab also offers keyset pagination via a Link response header, but the declarative engine cannot parse a Link header, so this operation uses the offset form only.

projectId.description: Numeric project id, or the namespace/project path (e.g. "mygroup/myproject") — pass it raw; it is encoded for you.

labels.description: Comma-separated label names to filter by.

perPage.description: Results per page, up to 100. Defaults to 20.

mergeRequests.merge.title: Merge Merge Request
mergeRequests.merge.description: Accept and merge a merge request by its project-scoped mergeRequestIid. sha, when supplied, must match the current HEAD of the source branch and is required if the group/instance requires a commit SHA on this API. auto_merge (not the deprecated merge_when_pipeline_succeeds) merges once checks pass. GitLab documents five failure codes, all surfaced as CONNECTOR_UPSTREAM_ERROR with GitLab's own message: 400 ("SHA must be provided when merging"), 401 (no permission), 405 (the merge request cannot merge), 409 ("SHA does not match HEAD of source branch" — the supplied sha is stale), and 422 ("Branch cannot be merged").

projectId.description: Numeric project id, or the namespace/project path (e.g. "mygroup/myproject") — pass it raw; it is encoded for you.

mergeRequestIid.description: Project-scoped merge request iid (not the global id).

sha.description: Commit SHA that must match the current HEAD of the source branch.

autoMerge.description: Merge automatically once all checks pass.

shouldRemoveSourceBranch.description: Delete the source branch once merged.

pipelines.create.title: Create Pipeline
pipelines.create.description: Trigger a new pipeline for a branch or tag ref. Note this endpoint is singular "pipeline", unlike the plural "pipelines" used to list and get.

projectId.description: Numeric project id, or the namespace/project path (e.g. "mygroup/myproject") — pass it raw; it is encoded for you.

ref.description: Branch or tag to run the pipeline for.

inputs.description: Pipeline inputs as a key/value object.

pipelines.get.title: Get Pipeline
pipelines.get.description: Fetch a single pipeline by its id. Note this endpoint is plural "pipelines", unlike the singular "pipeline" used to create.

projectId.description: Numeric project id, or the namespace/project path (e.g. "mygroup/myproject") — pass it raw; it is encoded for you.

pipelines.list.title: List Pipelines
pipelines.list.description: List the pipelines for a project. Note this endpoint is plural "pipelines", unlike the singular "pipeline" used to create. Uses GitLab's offset pagination: pass page and perPage (max 100). The response carries no cursor in its body — the next page number comes back in the x-next-page response header and is mapped to nextPage here, empty once the last page is reached. GitLab also offers keyset pagination via a Link response header, but the declarative engine cannot parse a Link header, so this operation uses the offset form only.

projectId.description: Numeric project id, or the namespace/project path (e.g. "mygroup/myproject") — pass it raw; it is encoded for you.

ref.description: Filter by branch or tag ref.

perPage.description: Results per page, up to 100. Defaults to 20.

projects.list.title: List Projects
projects.list.description: List projects visible to the caller. Pass membership=true and simple=true for the "which projects can I act on" call an agent typically needs. Uses GitLab's offset pagination: pass page and perPage (max 100). The response carries no cursor in its body — the next page number comes back in the x-next-page response header and is mapped to nextPage here, empty once the last page is reached. GitLab also offers keyset pagination via a Link response header, but the declarative engine cannot parse a Link header, so this operation uses the offset form only.

membership.description: Only projects the caller is a member of.

search.description: Search project path, name, or description.

simple.description: Return a limited, cheaper field set.

perPage.description: Results per page, up to 100. Defaults to 20.

projects.get.title: Get Project
projects.get.description: Fetch a single project. projectId is the numeric project id, or the namespace/project path (e.g. "diaspora/diaspora") passed raw — it is percent-encoded for you automatically.

projectId.description: Numeric project id, or the namespace/project path (e.g. "mygroup/myproject") — pass it raw; it is encoded for you.

projects.create.title: Create Project
projects.create.description: Create a GitLab project. name is required. path defaults to a slug of name when omitted. visibility is private, internal, or public. namespaceId places the project in a group; omit it to create under the authenticated user.

path.description: Project path (URL slug). Defaults to a slug of name.

namespaceId.description: Group or user namespace id to create the project in.

initializeWithReadme.description: Create a README on the default branch.

projects.update.title: Update Project
projects.update.description: Update a project. projectId is the numeric project id or the namespace/project path. Omitted fields are left unchanged.

projectId.description: Numeric project id, or the namespace/project path (e.g. "mygroup/myproject") — pass it raw; it is encoded for you.

issues.close.title: Close Issue
issues.close.description: Close an issue by its project-scoped issueIid. This is a dedicated close: it always sends state_event=close. Use issues.update to change other fields or to reopen.

projectId.description: Numeric project id, or the namespace/project path (e.g. "mygroup/myproject") — pass it raw; it is encoded for you.

issueIid.description: Project-scoped issue iid (not the global id).

mergeRequests.notes.create.title: Comment on Merge Request
mergeRequests.notes.create.description: Add a comment (note) to a merge request, addressed by its project-scoped mergeRequestIid. body is limited to 1,000,000 characters. The response note carries no web_url field.

projectId.description: Numeric project id, or the namespace/project path (e.g. "mygroup/myproject") — pass it raw; it is encoded for you.

mergeRequestIid.description: Project-scoped merge request iid (not the global id).

internal.description: Mark the note internal (visible only to members).

jobs.list.title: List Pipeline Jobs
jobs.list.description: List the jobs in a pipeline. Uses GitLab's offset pagination: pass page and perPage (max 100). The next page number comes back in the x-next-page response header and is mapped to nextPage here.

projectId.description: Numeric project id, or the namespace/project path (e.g. "mygroup/myproject") — pass it raw; it is encoded for you.

perPage.description: Results per page, up to 100. Defaults to 20.

jobs.get.title: Get Job
jobs.get.description: Fetch a single job by its id.

projectId.description: Numeric project id, or the namespace/project path (e.g. "mygroup/myproject") — pass it raw; it is encoded for you.

repository.files.get.title: Get Repository File
repository.files.get.description: Fetch a single file from a repository. filePath is the path within the repo (e.g. "docs/README.md") passed raw — slashes are percent-encoded for you. ref is required (branch, tag, or commit SHA). GitLab returns the file content as base64 in content.

projectId.description: Numeric project id, or the namespace/project path (e.g. "mygroup/myproject") — pass it raw; it is encoded for you.

filePath.description: Path of the file in the repository (e.g. "src/main.rs"). Pass it raw; slashes are encoded for you.

ref.description: Branch, tag, or commit SHA to read from.

groups.list.title: List Groups
groups.list.description: List groups visible to the caller. Uses GitLab's offset pagination: pass page and perPage (max 100). The next page number comes back in the x-next-page response header and is mapped to nextPage here.

minAccessLevel.description: Minimum access level the caller must have.

perPage.description: Results per page, up to 100. Defaults to 20.

groups.get.title: Get Group
groups.get.description: Fetch a single group. groupId is the numeric group id, or the full group path (e.g. "foo-bar/nested") passed raw — it is percent-encoded for you automatically.

groupId.description: Numeric group id, or the full group path (e.g. "mygroup/subgroup") — pass it raw; it is encoded for you.

branches.list.title: List Branches
branches.list.description: List repository branches for a project. Uses GitLab's offset pagination: pass page and perPage (max 100). The next page number comes back in the x-next-page response header and is mapped to nextPage here.

projectId.description: Numeric project id, or the namespace/project path (e.g. "mygroup/myproject") — pass it raw; it is encoded for you.

regex.description: Filter branch names by a regular expression.

perPage.description: Results per page, up to 100. Defaults to 20.

repository.commits.list.title: List Commits
repository.commits.list.description: List repository commits for a project. refName selects a branch, tag, or SHA. Uses GitLab's offset pagination: pass page and perPage (max 100). The next page number comes back in the x-next-page response header and is mapped to nextPage here.

projectId.description: Numeric project id, or the namespace/project path (e.g. "mygroup/myproject") — pass it raw; it is encoded for you.

refName.description: Branch, tag, or commit SHA to list commits from.

since.description: Only commits after this ISO 8601 timestamp.

until.description: Only commits before this ISO 8601 timestamp.

path.description: Only commits that touch this file path.

perPage.description: Results per page, up to 100. Defaults to 20.

issues.addSpentTime.title: Add Spent Time
issues.addSpentTime.description: Adds spent time to a GitLab issue for time tracking purposes. This action logs time against an issue, accumulating with any previously logged time. Use this action when you need to record time spent working on an issue, track billable hours, or maintain project time logs.

projectId.description: The global ID or URL-encoded path of the project.

summary.description: A summary of how the time was spent.

duration.description: The duration in human-readable format (e.g., '3h30m', '1h', '30m', '1d'). Supports combinations of years (y), months (mo), weeks (w), days (d), hours (h), and minutes (m).

issueIid.description: The internal ID of the project's issue.

mergeRequests.approve.title: Approve Merge Request
mergeRequests.approve.description: Approves a merge request in a GitLab project. Use this action when you need to record an approval from the authenticated user on a specific merge request. The authenticated user must be an eligible approver with appropriate permissions. Note that this action is idempotent — calling it multiple times on the same merge request will not create duplicate approvals.

projectId.description: The ID or URL-encoded path of the project.

sha.description: HEAD commit SHA for validation. If provided, the approval will fail with 409 if the merge request HEAD does not match this SHA.

approvalPassword.description: Current user's password, required only if project settings enforce re-authentication for approvals.

mergeRequestIid.description: Internal ID of the merge request to approve.

projects.archive.title: Archive Project
projects.archive.description: Tool to archive a project. Use when you need to mark a project read-only after finishing active development. Call after confirming no further changes are required.

projectId.description: The ID or URL-encoded path of the project to archive.

jobs.cancel.title: Cancel Job
jobs.cancel.description: Cancel a GitLab CI/CD job within a specified project. This action stops a running or pending job and is irreversible. Use this action when you need to cancel a job that is running, pending, or stuck in a canceling state. The optional force parameter allows cancellation of jobs that are in a canceling state. Once canceled, the job cannot be restarted.

force.description: Forces cancellation of a job in canceling state when set to true.

jobId.description: The ID of the job to cancel.

projectId.description: The ID or URL-encoded path of the project.

pipelines.cancel.title: Cancel Pipeline
pipelines.cancel.description: Tool to cancel a running pipeline in a GitLab project. Use this action when you need to stop a CI/CD pipeline that is currently executing or queued. Note that the API returns success (200) regardless of the pipeline's state, so this action can be safely called even if the pipeline has already finished or been canceled.

projectId.description: The ID or URL-encoded path of the project.

pipelineId.description: The ID of the pipeline to cancel.

repository.commits.create.title: Create Commit
repository.commits.create.description: Creates a new commit with multiple file operations in a GitLab project. This action supports batch operations including creating, updating, deleting, moving files, and changing file permissions in a single atomic commit. Use this action when you need to perform multiple file changes at once or when you need to commit changes to a GitLab repository programmatically. Note: Commits over 20 MB are rate-limited to 3 requests per 30 seconds, and commits over 300 MB are rejected.

force.description: When true, overwrites the target branch with a new commit history. Use with caution as this rewrites Git history.

stats.description: Include commit statistics (additions, deletions, total) in the response. Defaults to true.

branch.description: Target branch name where the commit will be created.

actions.description: List of file operations to perform in this commit. Each action represents a file change (create, update, delete, move, or chmod).

startSha.description: SHA of the commit to start the new commit from. Must be a 40-character SHA-1 hash.

projectId.description: The ID or URL-encoded path of the project.

authorName.description: Author name for the commit. Defaults to the authenticated user's name.

authorEmail.description: Author email address for the commit. Defaults to the authenticated user's email.

startBranch.description: Name of the branch to start the new commit from. If not provided, uses the target branch.

startProject.description: Project ID or URL-encoded path of the source project for the parent commit. Used when creating commits from another project's branch.

commitMessage.description: The commit message describing the changes.

repository.commits.createComment.title: Create Commit Comment
repository.commits.createComment.description: Posts a comment to a specific commit in a GitLab project repository. Use this action when you need to provide feedback, review notes, or discussion on a particular commit. Line-specific comments require both path and line parameters; if invalid, the comment is placed at the commit level.

sha.description: The commit hash or name of a repository branch or tag.

line.description: The line number where the comment should be placed. Requires path to be specified.

note.description: The text content of the comment.

path.description: The file path relative to the repository. Required if line or line_type is specified.

lineType.description: The type of line ('new' or 'old'). Requires path and line to be specified.

projectId.description: The ID or URL-encoded path of the project.

repository.files.create.title: Create Repository File
repository.files.create.description: Creates a new file in a GitLab repository at the specified path with the given content. Use this action when you need to add a new file to a repository branch with a commit message.

branch.description: The name of the branch where the file will be created.

content.description: The content of the file to create.

encoding.description: The encoding of the file content. Set to 'base64' if the content is base64-encoded. Default is 'text'.

filePath.description: The full path to the file to create within the repository (e.g., 'lib/class.rb' or 'docs/README.md').

projectId.description: The ID or URL-encoded path of the project.

authorName.description: The name of the commit author. If not provided, uses the authenticated user's name.

authorEmail.description: The email address of the commit author. If not provided, uses the authenticated user's email.

startBranch.description: Name of the base branch to create the new branch from. Only used if the specified branch does not exist.

commitMessage.description: The commit message describing why the file was created.

executeFilemode.description: Whether to enable the execute flag on the file (for executable files).

groups.create.title: Create GitLab Group
groups.create.description: Tool to create a new group in GitLab. Use when you need to establish a new group for projects or collaboration.

parentId.description: The parent group ID for creating nested group.

lfsEnabled.description: Enable/disable Large File Storage (LFS) for the projects in this group.

defaultBranch.description: The default branch name for group’s projects.

membershipLock.description: Users cannot be added to projects in this group. Premium and Ultimate only.

organizationId.description: The organization ID for the group.

mentionsDisabled.description: Disable the capability of a group from getting mentioned.

autoDevopsEnabled.description: Default to Auto DevOps pipeline for all projects within this group.

shareWithGroupLock.description: Prevent sharing a project with another group within this group.

requestAccessEnabled.description: Allow users to request member access.

twoFactorGracePeriod.description: Time before Two-factor authentication is enforced (in hours).

experimentFeaturesEnabled.description: Enable experiment features for this group.

sharedRunnersMinutesLimit.description: Can be set by administrators only. Maximum number of monthly compute minutes for this group. Can be nil (default; inherit system default), 0 (unlimited), or > 0. GitLab Self-Managed, Premium and Ultimate only.

requireTwoFactorAuthentication.description: Require all users in this group to set up two-factor authentication.

defaultBranchProtectionDefaults.description: Options for default_branch_protection_defaults. E.g. {"allowed_to_push": [{"access_level":40}], "allow_force_push": False, "allowed_to_merge": [{"access_level":40}], "developer_can_initial_push": False}

extraSharedRunnersMinutesLimit.description: Can be set by administrators only. Additional compute minutes for this group. GitLab Self-Managed, Premium and Ultimate only.

labels.create.title: Create Label
labels.create.description: Creates a new label for a GitLab project with specified name, color, and optional attributes. Use this action when you need to create a new label for organizing issues and merge requests within a project. Labels help categorize and filter project items, making project management more efficient.

projectId.description: The ID or URL-encoded path of the project (e.g., '12345', 'my-group/my-project', or 'my-group%2Fmy-project').

color.description: The color of the label given in 6-digit hex notation with leading '#' sign (e.g., #FFAABB) or CSS color names.

archived.description: If true, marks the label as archived. Default value: false.

priority.description: The priority of the label. Must be greater than or equal to zero or null to remove priority.

mergeRequests.draftNotes.create.title: Create Merge Request Draft Note
mergeRequests.draftNotes.create.description: Creates and saves an unpublished merge request draft note that is visible only to its author. Use this action when the requested outcome is a saved draft for later publication; it does not publish a comment.

note.description: Content of the unpublished draft note. Whitespace-only notes are rejected.

commitId.description: Commit SHA to associate with the draft note.

projectId.description: The numeric project ID or namespace/project path. URL encoding is handled automatically.

mergeRequestIid.description: The project-local IID of the merge request.

resolveDiscussion.description: Whether publishing this draft should resolve its discussion.

inReplyToDiscussionId.description: Discussion ID to which this draft note replies.

milestones.create.title: Create Milestone
milestones.create.description: Creates a new milestone in a GitLab project. Milestones track progress towards a goal with a start date, due date, and associated issues. Use this action when you need to establish a new project milestone for organizing work, tracking release schedules, or planning sprints.

projectId.description: The ID or URL-encoded path of the project (e.g., '12345' or 'my-group/my-project').

dueDate.description: The due date of the milestone in YYYY-MM-DD format.

startDate.description: The start date of the milestone in YYYY-MM-DD format.

branches.create.title: Create Repository Branch
branches.create.description: Tool to create a new branch in a project. Use when you need to create a new branch from an existing branch or a specific commit in a GitLab project.

ref.description: The branch name or commit SHA to create the new branch from.

projectId.description: The ID or URL-encoded path of the project.

branchName.description: The name of the new branch.

projectHooks.create.title: Create Project Webhook
projectHooks.create.description: Creates a new webhook (project hook) for a GitLab project to receive real-time event notifications. Use this action when you need to set up automated integrations that respond to GitLab events like pushes, merge requests, issues, or CI/CD pipeline activities. Configure which events trigger the webhook by enabling the appropriate event flags. The webhook will send POST requests to your specified URL whenever the configured events occur.

projectId.description: The ID or URL-encoded path of the project.

url.description: The URL to send webhook payloads to.

token.description: Secret token for validating webhook payloads. GitLab includes this token in the X-Gitlab-Token header of webhook requests.

jobEvents.description: Trigger webhook on job/CI job events.

emojiEvents.description: Trigger webhook on emoji reaction events.

tagPushEvents.description: Trigger webhook on tag push events.

wikiPageEvents.description: Trigger webhook on wiki page events.

featureFlagEvents.description: Trigger webhook on feature flag events.

mergeRequestsEvents.description: Trigger webhook on merge request events.

branchFilterStrategy.description: Strategy for filtering branches: 'wildcard' for glob patterns, 'regex' for regular expressions, 'all_branches' to trigger on all branches.

customWebhookTemplate.description: Custom payload format/template for webhook requests.

enableSslVerification.description: Enable SSL certificate verification when sending webhook requests. Set to false for self-signed certificates (not recommended for production).

confidentialNoteEvents.description: Trigger webhook on confidential comment/note events.

pushEventsBranchFilter.description: Branch name or glob pattern to filter push events. Only pushes to matching branches trigger the webhook.

confidentialIssuesEvents.description: Trigger webhook on confidential issue events.

resourceAccessTokenEvents.description: Trigger webhook on project access token expiry events.

resourceDeployTokenEvents.description: Trigger webhook on deploy token expiry events.

groups.delete.title: Delete Group
groups.delete.description: Deletes a GitLab group by its ID or URL-encoded path. Use this action when you need to remove a group entirely. This action is irreversible — the group cannot be recovered once permanently removed. On GitLab.com, groups are retained for 30 days before permanent deletion unless permanently_remove=true is specified. You must have Owner permissions on the group to delete it.

groupId.description: The ID or URL-encoded path of the group to be deleted.

fullPath.description: The full path of the group (e.g., parent_group/subgroup). Required when permanently_remove=true.

permanentlyRemove.description: If true, the group is deleted immediately. Otherwise, it is marked for deletion and removed after a retention period (30 days on GitLab.com, configurable on self-managed).

issues.notes.delete.title: Delete Issue Note
issues.notes.delete.description: Deletes a note (comment) from an issue in a GitLab project. Use this action when you need to remove a specific comment from an issue. This action is irreversible — the note cannot be recovered once deleted.

projectId.description: The ID or URL-encoded path of the project.

noteId.description: The ID of the note to delete.

issueIid.description: The internal ID of the issue.

labels.delete.title: Delete Label
labels.delete.description: Deletes a label from a GitLab project by its ID or title. Use this action when you need to remove a label from a project permanently. This action is irreversible — the label cannot be recovered once deleted.

projectId.description: The ID or URL-encoded path of the project.

labelId.description: The ID or title of the label to delete.

mergeRequests.delete.title: Delete Merge Request
mergeRequests.delete.description: Tool to permanently delete a merge request from a GitLab project. Use when you need to remove a merge request entirely, though closing is typically preferred to preserve the discussion history and audit trail. This action is irreversible — the merge request and its associated data cannot be recovered once deleted.

projectId.description: The ID or URL-encoded path of the project.

mergeRequestIid.description: Internal ID of the merge request to delete.

milestones.delete.title: Delete Milestone
milestones.delete.description: Deletes a project milestone by its ID. Use when you need to permanently remove a milestone from a project. This action is irreversible — the milestone cannot be recovered once deleted. Requires at minimum the Planner role for the project.

projectId.description: The ID or URL-encoded path of the project.

milestoneId.description: The ID of the milestone to delete.

pipelines.delete.title: Delete Pipeline
pipelines.delete.description: Tool to delete a CI/CD pipeline by its ID within a specified project. This action expires all pipeline caches and deletes all immediately related objects such as builds, logs, artifacts, and triggers. This action is irreversible — the pipeline cannot be recovered once deleted. Use when you need to permanently remove a pipeline and all its associated data.

projectId.description: The ID or URL-encoded path of the project.

pipelineId.description: The ID of the pipeline to delete.

projects.delete.title: Delete Project
projects.delete.description: Tool to delete a GitLab project by its ID. Use when you need to remove a project, either by marking it for later deletion or deleting it immediately.

projectId.description: The ID or URL-encoded path of the project to be deleted.

fullPath.description: The full path of the project (e.g., namespace/project_name). Used with `permanently_remove=true` for immediate deletion. Available in GitLab Free from 18.0 (previously Premium/Ultimate only since 15.11).

permanentlyRemove.description: If true, the project is deleted immediately. Otherwise, it is marked for deletion and removed after a retention period. Available in GitLab Free from 18.0 (previously Premium/Ultimate only since 15.11).

branches.delete.title: Delete Repository Branch
branches.delete.description: Tool to delete a branch from a GitLab project repository. Use when you need to remove a branch that is no longer needed. This action is irreversible — the branch cannot be recovered once deleted. Cannot delete default or protected branches.

projectId.description: The ID or URL-encoded path of the project.

branchName.description: The URL-encoded name of the branch to delete. Cannot be the default or a protected branch.

repository.files.delete.title: Delete Repository File
repository.files.delete.description: Deletes a file from a GitLab repository by creating a new commit. Use this action when you need to remove a file from a project's repository on a specific branch. This action is irreversible — the file will be removed from the specified branch, though it remains in the git history and can be recovered from previous commits.

branch.description: Name of the branch where the file will be deleted.

filePath.description: URL-encoded full path to the file to delete (e.g., 'lib/class.rb' or 'docs/readme.md').

projectId.description: The ID or URL-encoded path of the project.

authorName.description: The commit author's name. If not provided, uses the authenticated user's name.

authorEmail.description: The commit author's email address. If not provided, uses the authenticated user's email.

startBranch.description: Name of the base branch to create the new branch from. Used when the target branch doesn't exist yet.

commitMessage.description: Commit message describing the file deletion.

lastCommitId.description: Last known commit ID for the file. Used to detect concurrent modifications. If provided and the file has been modified since this commit, the deletion will fail.

projectHooks.delete.title: Delete Webhook
projectHooks.delete.description: Deletes a project webhook/hook permanently from a GitLab project, removing the integration and stopping all event notifications. Use this action when you need to remove a webhook that is no longer needed or to clean up unused integrations. This action is irreversible — the webhook cannot be recovered once deleted.

projectId.description: The ID or URL-encoded path of the project.

hookId.description: The ID of the webhook to delete.

projects.downloadAvatar.title: Download Project Avatar
projects.downloadAvatar.description: Tool to download a project's avatar image. Use when you need the raw avatar bytes after confirming the project exists.

projectId.description: The ID or URL-encoded path of the project whose avatar to download.

jobs.erase.title: Erase Job
jobs.erase.description: Tool to erase the content of a specified job within a project. Use when you need to remove job artifacts and logs.

jobId.description: The ID of the job to be erased.

projectId.description: The ID or URL-encoded path of the project.

projects.fork.title: Fork Project
projects.fork.description: Forks a GitLab project to a specified namespace or the current user's namespace. Creates an independent copy of the project that maintains a relationship with the source. Use this action when you need to create a personal or team copy of a project for development, experimentation, or contribution workflows.

projectId.description: The ID or URL-encoded path of the project to fork.

name.description: The name for the forked project. If not specified, the name of the original project is used.

path.description: The path (URL-friendly name) for the forked project. If not specified, the path of the original project is used.

namespace.description: The ID or path of the namespace where the forked project will be created. If not specified, defaults to the current user's namespace.

description.description: The description for the forked project. If not specified, the description of the original project is used.

mrDefaultTargetSelf.description: If true, merge requests in the forked project will target itself by default. If false, merge requests target the upstream (source) project. Defaults to false.

repository.commits.refs.title: Get Commit References
repository.commits.refs.description: Tool to get all references (branches or tags) a commit is pushed to. Use when you need to find out which branches or tags a specific commit belongs to in a GitLab project.

projectId.description: The ID or URL-encoded path of the project.

perPage.description: Page size. GitLab defaults to 20 and caps at 100.

repository.commits.sequence.title: Get Commit Sequence
repository.commits.sequence.description: Tool to get the sequence number of a commit in a project by following parent links from the given commit. Use when you need to determine the order of a commit in the project's history.

projectId.description: The ID or URL-encoded path of the project.

firstParent.description: Follow only the first parent commit upon seeing a merge commit.

groups.members.get.title: Get Group Member
groups.members.get.description: Tool to retrieve details for a specific group member. Use when you need to fetch membership information for a user in a group after you know both group ID and user ID.

groupId.description: The ID or URL-encoded path of the group.

userId.description: The user ID of the group member to retrieve.

issues.notes.get.title: Get Issue Note
issues.notes.get.description: Retrieves a single comment (note) from a GitLab issue by its ID. Use this action when you need to fetch the details of a specific note on an issue, including its content, author information, and metadata.

projectId.description: The ID or URL-encoded path of the project.

noteId.description: The ID of the specific note to retrieve.

jobs.trace.title: Get Job Trace
jobs.trace.description: Retrieves the trace (log output) for a specific CI/CD job within a project. Use this action when you need to view the execution logs of a job to debug failures, check output, or monitor job progress. The trace contains the complete console output from the job execution.

projectId.description: The ID or URL-encoded path of the project.

labels.get.title: Get Project Label
labels.get.description: Retrieves a single project label by its ID or title. Use this action when you need to fetch details about a specific label within a GitLab project, such as its color, description, or associated issue/MR counts.

projectId.description: The ID or URL-encoded path of the project.

includeAncestorGroups.description: Include ancestor groups. Defaults to true.

mergeRequests.approvals.get.title: Get Merge Request Approvals
mergeRequests.approvals.get.description: Retrieves aggregate approval status for a GitLab merge request on any GitLab tier. Returns every approving user, even when an approval does not satisfy a specific approval rule. Use Get Merge Request Approval State instead when Premium or Ultimate rule-level satisfaction is needed.

projectId.description: The ID or URL-encoded path of the GitLab project.

mergeRequestIid.description: The project-scoped internal ID (IID) of the merge request.

mergeRequests.approvalState.get.title: Get Merge Request Approval State
mergeRequests.approvalState.get.description: Retrieves rule-level approval satisfaction for a GitLab merge request. This endpoint requires GitLab Premium or Ultimate and shows which users count toward each rule, not every user who approved. Use Get Merge Request Approvals for all-tier aggregate status and the complete approving-user list.

projectId.description: The ID or URL-encoded path of the GitLab project.

mergeRequestIid.description: The project-scoped internal ID (IID) of the merge request.

mergeRequests.notes.list.title: Get Merge Request Notes
mergeRequests.notes.list.description: Tool to fetch comments on a merge request. Use when you need to retrieve all notes for a specific merge request.

projectId.description: The ID or URL-encoded path of the project.

perPage.description: Number of notes per page (max 100).

mergeRequestIid.description: Internal ID of the merge request.

milestones.get.title: Get Milestone
milestones.get.description: Retrieves a single milestone by its ID for a specific project. Returns detailed information including title, description, dates, and state. Use when you need to fetch complete details about a specific milestone.

projectId.description: The ID or URL-encoded path of the project.

milestoneId.description: The ID of the milestone within the project.

projects.languages.title: Get Project Languages
projects.languages.description: Tool to list programming languages used in a project with percentages. Use when you need the project language breakdown.

projectId.description: The ID or URL-encoded path of the project.

projects.members.get.title: Get Project Member
projects.members.get.description: Tool to retrieve details for a specific project member. Use after confirming project and user IDs to fetch membership information for a project member.

projectId.description: The ID or URL-encoded path of the project.

userId.description: The user ID of the project member to retrieve.

projects.members.getAll.title: Get Project Member All
projects.members.getAll.description: Tool to retrieve details for a specific project member (including inherited and invited members). Use when you need the effective membership info (including invitations and inheritance).

projectId.description: The ID or URL-encoded path of the project.

userId.description: The user ID of the project member.

mergeRequests.commits.list.title: Get Merge Request Commits
mergeRequests.commits.list.description: Tool to get commits of a merge request. Use when you need to retrieve all commits associated with a specific merge request.

projectId.description: The ID or URL-encoded path of the project.

mergeRequestIid.description: Internal ID of the merge request.

perPage.description: Page size. GitLab defaults to 20 and caps at 100.

mergeRequests.diffVersions.list.title: List Merge Request Diff Versions
mergeRequests.diffVersions.list.description: Tool to list all diff versions of a merge request. Use when you need to inspect changes across different diff versions after creating or updating a merge request.

projectId.description: The ID or URL-encoded path of the project.

mergeRequestIid.description: The internal ID of the merge request.

perPage.description: Page size. GitLab defaults to 20 and caps at 100.

repository.files.raw.title: Get Raw File
repository.files.raw.description: Retrieves the raw contents of a file from a GitLab repository without Base64 encoding. Use this action when you need to read the actual file content directly from a repository. Unlike the standard file retrieval endpoint, this returns unencoded file content.

lfs.description: When true, returns Git LFS file contents instead of the pointer file. Ignored for non-LFS tracked files.

ref.description: The name of branch, tag, or commit to retrieve the file from.

filePath.description: The full path to the file in the repository (e.g., 'app/models/key.rb').

projectId.description: The ID or URL-encoded path of the project.

branches.get.title: Get Repository Branch
branches.get.description: Tool to retrieve information about a specific branch in a project. Use when you need to get details for a single branch.

projectId.description: The ID or URL-encoded path of the project.

branchName.description: The URL-encoded name of the branch.

repository.commits.get.title: Get Single Commit
repository.commits.get.description: Tool to get a specific commit identified by the commit hash or name of a branch or tag. Use this when you need to retrieve detailed information about a single commit in a GitLab project repository.

projectId.description: The ID or URL-encoded path of the project.

sha.description: The commit hash or name of a repository branch or tag.

stats.description: Include commit stats. Default is true.

issues.timeStats.title: Get Issue Time Stats
issues.timeStats.description: Retrieves time tracking statistics for a specific issue in a project. Returns both machine-readable values (in seconds) and human-readable formatted durations. Use this action when you need to check time estimates, logged time, or track progress on an issue's time budget.

projectId.description: The ID or URL-encoded path of the project.

issueIid.description: The internal ID of the project's issue.

users.get.title: Get User
users.get.description: Tool to retrieve information about a specific user by their ID. Use when you need to fetch details for a single GitLab user.

users.list.title: Get Users
users.list.description: Tool to retrieve a list of users from GitLab. Use this when you need to find user information, search for specific users, or filter users based on various criteria like activity status or creation date.

active.description: Filters only active users. Default is false.

admins.description: Return only administrators. Default is false. (Admin only)

humans.description: Filters only regular users that are not bot or internal users. Default is false.

search.description: Search for users by name, username, or public email.

blocked.description: Filters only blocked users. Default is false.

auditors.description: Return only auditor users. Default is false. If not included, it returns all users. (Admin only, Premium and Ultimate only)

external.description: Filters only external users. Default is false.

perPage.description: Number of items per page for pagination.

username.description: Get a single user with a specific username.

skipLdap.description: Skip LDAP users. (Admin only, Premium and Ultimate only)

externUid.description: Get a single user with a specific external authentication provider UID. (Admin only)

createdAfter.description: Return users created after specified time (ISO 8601 format: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ).

createdBefore.description: Return users created before specified time (ISO 8601 format: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ).

excludeActive.description: Filters only non active users. Default is false.

excludeHumans.description: Filters only bot or internal users. Default is false.

excludeExternal.description: Filters only non external users. Default is false.

excludeInternal.description: Filters only non internal users. Default is false.

withoutProjects.description: Filter users without projects. Default is false. (Admin only)

withoutProjectBots.description: Filters user without project bots. Default is false.

users.status.getById.title: Get Any User's Status by ID
users.status.getById.description: Tool to get a user's status by ID. Use when you need to retrieve a GitLab user's current status message, emoji, and availability after identifying their user ID.

userId.description: The numeric ID of the GitLab user whose status you want to retrieve.

projectHooks.get.title: Get Webhook
projectHooks.get.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific project webhook by its ID. Use this action when you need to inspect a webhook's configuration, including its URL, enabled event triggers, SSL verification settings, and authentication details. This is useful for verifying webhook configurations or before updating webhook settings.

hookId.description: The ID of the webhook/hook to retrieve.

projectId.description: The ID or URL-encoded path of the project.

projects.importMembers.title: Import project members
projects.importMembers.description: Tool to import members from one project to another. Use when migrating members between projects.

projectId.description: ID or URL-encoded path of the target project to receive members.

sourceProjectId.description: ID or URL-encoded path of the source project to import members from.

groups.members.listAll.title: List All Group Members
groups.members.listAll.description: Tool to list all members of a group including direct, inherited, and invited members. Use when you need a comprehensive membership list beyond direct members.

groupId.description: The ID or URL-encoded path of the group.

perPage.description: Number of items per page for pagination.

projects.members.listAll.title: List All Project Members
projects.members.listAll.description: Tool to list all members of a project (direct, inherited, invited). Use when you need the effective membership list including inherited and invited members.

projectId.description: The ID or URL-encoded path of the project.

query.description: Filters results based on a given name, email, or username. Use partial values to widen the scope of the query.

perPage.description: Number of items per page for pagination.

userIds.description: Filter the results on the given user IDs.

groups.billableMembers.list.title: List Billable Group Members
groups.billableMembers.list.description: Tool to list billable members of a top-level group (including its subgroups and projects). Use when generating billing reports; requires Owner role on the group.

groupId.description: The ID or URL-encoded path of the top-level group. Only top-level groups are supported.

search.description: Search string to filter members by name, username, or public email.

perPage.description: Number of items per page for pagination (must be ≥ 1).

repository.commits.listComments.title: List Commit Comments
repository.commits.listComments.description: Retrieves all comments associated with a specific commit in a GitLab project. Use this action when you need to view discussions or feedback left on a particular commit, including both general comments and inline code review comments.

sha.description: The commit hash or name of a repository branch or tag.

projectId.description: The ID or URL-encoded path of the project.

perPage.description: Page size. GitLab defaults to 20 and caps at 100.

groups.members.list.title: List Group Members
groups.members.list.description: Tool to list direct members of a group. Use when you need to retrieve or filter a group's direct membership.

groupId.description: The ID or URL-encoded path of the group.

query.description: Filter members by name, username, or email substring.

active.description: When true, return only active users.

perPage.description: Number of results per page (1–100).

relations.description: Membership relation types to include: direct, descendants, inherited, or shared.

skipUsers.description: List of user IDs to exclude from the results.

includeInherited.description: Include members inherited from ancestor groups when true.

groups.projects.list.title: List Group Projects
groups.projects.list.description: Tool to list projects within a GitLab group by group ID or full path. Use when discovering projects under a namespace or subgroup.

groupId.description: The ID or URL-encoded path of the group.

owned.description: Limit by projects owned by the current user.

search.description: Return list of projects matching the search criteria.

simple.description: Return only limited fields for each project.

starred.description: Limit by projects starred by the current user.

perPage.description: Number of items per page (1-100).

withShared.description: Include projects shared to this group. Default is true.

minAccessLevel.description: Limit to projects where current user has at least this access level.

includeSubgroups.description: Include projects in subgroups of this group. Default is false.

withIssuesEnabled.description: Limit by projects with issues feature enabled. Default is false.

withSecurityReports.description: Return only projects with security reports artifacts. Default is false.

withCustomAttributes.description: Include custom attributes in response (administrators only).

withMergeRequestsEnabled.description: Limit by projects with merge requests feature enabled. Default is false.

issues.notes.list.title: List Issue Notes
issues.notes.list.description: Retrieves all notes (comments and activity) for a specific project issue in GitLab. Use this action when you need to view the discussion history, comments, or activity log on an issue to understand the context or follow up on conversations. Results are paginated and can be filtered by activity type or sorted by creation/update time.

projectId.description: The ID or URL-encoded path of the project.

page.description: Page number to retrieve. Default is 1.

perPage.description: Number of notes per page. Default is 25, maximum is 100.

issueIid.description: The internal ID of the project issue.

labels.list.title: List Labels
labels.list.description: Lists all labels for a project with optional filtering by name, archived status, and ancestor inclusion. Use this action when you need to retrieve available labels for a project to categorize issues or merge requests, or to check which labels exist before assigning them.

projectId.description: The ID or URL-encoded path of the project. Can be a numeric ID (e.g., 123) or namespace path in format 'namespace/project-name' (e.g., 'my-group/my-project').

page.description: Page number for pagination. Defaults to 1.

search.description: Keyword to filter labels by name.

archived.description: If true, returns only archived labels. If unset, returns all labels.

perPage.description: Number of labels per page. Defaults to 20.

withCounts.description: Whether or not to include issue and merge request counts. Defaults to false.

includeAncestorGroups.description: Include labels from ancestor groups. Defaults to true.

mergeRequests.diffs.list.title: List Merge Request Diffs
mergeRequests.diffs.list.description: List the files changed by a GitLab merge request, including patch content.

page.description: Page number to return. Defaults to 1.

unidiff.description: If true, return each change in unified diff format.

perPage.description: Number of changed files per page, from 1 to 100. Defaults to 20.

projectId.description: The numeric ID or namespace path of the project.

mergeRequestIid.description: The internal ID of the merge request.

mergeRequests.discussions.list.title: List Merge Request Discussions
mergeRequests.discussions.list.description: Lists grouped discussion threads and their notes for a merge request.

perPage.description: Number of discussions to return per page, from 1 to 100.

projectId.description: The numeric project ID or namespace/project path. URL encoding is handled automatically.

mergeRequestIid.description: The project-local IID of the merge request.

mergeRequests.listAll.title: List Merge Requests
mergeRequests.listAll.description: Retrieves a list of merge requests from across all accessible projects based on scope and filters. Use this action when you need to query merge requests at the instance or user level (not scoped to a specific project), such as finding all merge requests created by a user, assigned to a user, or awaiting review. By default returns merge requests created by the authenticated user; use scope=all to retrieve all accessible merge requests.

page.description: The page of results to return. Defaults to 1.

view.description: If simple, returns the iid, URL, title, description, and basic state of merge request.

draft.description: Filter merge requests by draft status. True returns draft merge requests, False returns non-draft merge requests.

labels.description: Returns merge requests matching a comma-separated list of labels. Use None to list all merge requests with no labels or Any to list all merge requests with at least one label. Predefined names are case-insensitive.

search.description: Search merge requests against their title and description.

perPage.description: The number of results per page. Defaults to 25.

authorId.description: Returns merge requests created by the given user ID. Mutually exclusive with author_username.

milestone.description: Returns merge requests for a specific milestone. Use None for merge requests with no milestone or Any for merge requests that have an assigned milestone.

notFilter.description: Returns merge requests that do not match the parameters supplied. Accepts: labels, milestone, author_id, author_username, assignee_id, assignee_username, reviewer_id, reviewer_username, my_reaction_emoji.

assigneeId.description: Returns merge requests assigned to the given user ID. Use string 'None' for unassigned merge requests or 'Any' for merge requests with an assignee.

environment.description: Returns merge requests deployed to the given environment.

reviewerId.description: Returns merge requests which have the user as a reviewer with the given user ID. Use string 'None' for merge requests with no reviewers or 'Any' for merge requests with any reviewer. Mutually exclusive with reviewer_username.

approverIds.description: Returns merge requests which have all the users with the given IDs as individual approvers. Use None for merge requests without approvers or Any for merge requests with an approver. Premium and Ultimate only.

nonArchived.description: Return merge requests from non-archived projects only. Default is true.

createdAfter.description: Returns merge requests created on or after the given time. Expected in ISO 8601 format.

mergeUserId.description: Returns merge requests merged by the user with the given user ID. Mutually exclusive with merge_user_username. Introduced in GitLab 17.0.

sourceBranch.description: Returns merge requests with the given source branch.

targetBranch.description: Returns merge requests with the given target branch.

updatedAfter.description: Returns merge requests updated on or after the given time. Expected in ISO 8601 format.

createdBefore.description: Returns merge requests created on or before the given time. Expected in ISO 8601 format.

deployedAfter.description: Returns merge requests deployed after the given date/time. Expected in ISO 8601 format.

updatedBefore.description: Returns merge requests updated on or before the given time. Expected in ISO 8601 format.

approvedByIds.description: Returns merge requests approved by all the users with the given IDs (up to 5 users). Use None for merge requests with no approvals or Any for merge requests with an approval. Premium and Ultimate only.

authorUsername.description: Returns merge requests created by the given username. Mutually exclusive with author_id.

deployedBefore.description: Returns merge requests deployed before the given date/time. Expected in ISO 8601 format.

assigneeUsername.description: Returns merge requests assigned to the given username(s). Array parameter.

myReactionEmoji.description: Returns merge requests reacted by the authenticated user by the given emoji. Use None for merge requests not given a reaction or Any for merge requests given at least one reaction.

reviewerUsername.description: Returns merge requests which have the user as a reviewer with the given username. Mutually exclusive with reviewer_id.

mergeUserUsername.description: Returns merge requests merged by the user with the given username. Mutually exclusive with merge_user_id. Introduced in GitLab 17.0.

withLabelsDetails.description: If true, response returns more details for each label in labels field: name, color, description, description_html, text_color. Default is false.

approvedByUsernames.description: Returns merge requests approved by all the users with the given usernames (up to 5 users). Premium and Ultimate only.

withMergeStatusRecheck.description: If true, this projection requests (but does not guarantee) an asynchronous recalculation of the merge_status field.

milestones.list.title: List Project Milestones
milestones.list.description: Lists all milestones for a specific project with optional filtering by state, title, or search terms. Use this action when you need to view project milestones, check milestone progress, or find a specific milestone by title or IID before creating or updating issues.

projectId.description: Project identifier: numeric ID (e.g., 123) or namespace path in format 'namespace/project-name' (e.g., 'my-group/my-project'). Path must use forward slash / as separator. URL-encoding is handled automatically.

iids.description: Return milestones with specific internal IDs. Ignored if include_ancestors is true.

title.description: Return milestones matching the exact title.

search.description: Search milestones by title or description content.

updatedAfter.description: Return milestones updated on or after this time. Expected in ISO 8601 format (2019-03-15T08:00:00Z).

updatedBefore.description: Return milestones updated on or before this time. Expected in ISO 8601 format (2019-03-15T08:00:00Z).

includeAncestors.description: Include milestones from parent groups. When true, iids parameter is ignored.

perPage.description: Page size. GitLab defaults to 20 and caps at 100.

groups.pendingMembers.list.title: List Pending Group Members
groups.pendingMembers.list.description: Tool to list pending members of a group and its subgroups and projects. Use when you need to review users awaiting approval or invited without an account. Call after confirming the top-level group ID.

groupId.description: The ID or URL-encoded path of the top-level group.

perPage.description: Number of items per page for pagination (max 100).

projects.groups.list.title: List Project Groups
projects.groups.list.description: Tool to list ancestor groups of a project. Use when you need to retrieve all groups a project belongs to or is shared with.

projectId.description: The ID or URL-encoded path of the project.

page.description: Page number of the results to retrieve.

search.description: Search for specific groups by name.

perPage.description: Number of items to return per page.

withShared.description: Include projects shared with this group. Default is false.

sharedVisibleOnly.description: Limit to shared groups user has access to.

sharedMinAccessLevel.description: Limit to shared groups with at least this access level.

projects.invitedGroups.list.title: List Project Invited Groups
projects.invitedGroups.list.description: Tool to list groups invited to a project. Use when auditing which groups have access to a project.

projectId.description: The ID or URL-encoded path of the project.

perPage.description: Number of items to return per page.

projects.shareableGroups.list.title: List Project Shareable Groups
projects.shareableGroups.list.description: Tool to list groups that can be shared with a project. Use before sharing a project to fetch eligible groups.

projectId.description: The ID or URL-encoded path of the project.

search.description: Search term to filter groups by name or path.

perPage.description: Number of items per page for pagination.

skipGroups.description: List of group IDs to exclude from the results.

projects.tags.list.title: List Project Repository Tags
projects.tags.list.description: Tool to retrieve a list of repository tags for a specified project. Use when you need to get all tags associated with a project in GitLab.

projectId.description: The ID or URL-encoded path of the project.

page.description: Page number of the results to retrieve.

search.description: Return a list of tags matching the search criteria. You can use `^term` and `term$` to find tags that begin and end with `term`.

perPage.description: Number of items to return per page.

projects.transferLocations.list.title: List Project Transfer Locations
projects.transferLocations.list.description: Tool to list namespaces available for project transfer. Use when you need to determine which groups a project can be transferred into.

projectId.description: The ID or URL-encoded path of the project.

search.description: The group names to search for.

perPage.description: Number of items per page for pagination.

projects.users.list.title: List project users
projects.users.list.description: Tool to list users of a project. Use after you have a project ID and want to retrieve its users.

projectId.description: The ID or URL-encoded path of the project.

search.description: Filter users by name or username.

perPage.description: Number of items per page for pagination (max 100).

skipUsers.description: List of user IDs to exclude from the result.

repository.tree.list.title: List Repository Tree
repository.tree.list.description: List files and directories in a GitLab project's repository tree.

ref.description: Branch, tag, or commit SHA to list. Defaults to the project's default branch.

path.description: Repository directory path to list. Omit to list the repository root.

perPage.description: Number of tree entries to return per page (1-100).

recursive.description: Whether to recursively include entries below the requested path.

pageToken.description: Opaque token from next_page_token for the next keyset page.

pagination.description: Set to keyset to use GitLab keyset pagination.

projectId.description: The numeric ID or namespace/project path of the project. URL-encoding is handled automatically.

withLastCommit.description: Whether to include the most recent commit for each tree entry. Cannot be combined with recursive=true.

users.projects.list.title: List User Projects
users.projects.list.description: Tool to list projects owned by a specific user. Use after obtaining target user identity to fetch owned projects.

userId.description: The ID or username of the user whose projects to list.

owned.description: Limit by projects explicitly owned by the specified user.

search.description: Return list of projects matching search criteria (case-insensitive substring).

simple.description: Return only limited fields for each project.

starred.description: Limit by projects starred by the specified user.

idAfter.description: Limit results to projects with IDs greater than the specified ID.

perPage.description: Number of items per page (1-100).

idBefore.description: Limit results to projects with IDs less than the specified ID.

membership.description: Limit by projects that the current user is a member of.

statistics.description: Include project statistics. Available to Reporter role and above.

updatedAfter.description: Limit projects updated after given time (ISO 8601).

updatedBefore.description: Limit projects updated before given time (ISO 8601).

minAccessLevel.description: Limit by current user minimal role (access_level).

withCustomAttributes.description: Include custom attributes in response (admin only).

withProgrammingLanguage.description: Limit by projects which use the given programming language.

withMergeRequestsEnabled.description: Limit by enabled merge requests feature.

projectHooks.list.title: List Webhooks
projectHooks.list.description: Tool to list all webhooks configured for a GitLab project. Returns webhook configurations including URLs, event triggers, and SSL settings. Use when you need to view existing webhooks for a project, audit webhook configurations, or check which events are being monitored. Webhook secret tokens are redacted from the response.

page.description: Page number for pagination. Defaults to 1.

perPage.description: Number of results per page. Defaults to 20, maximum is 100.

projectId.description: The ID or URL-encoded path of the project. Use numeric ID (e.g., 123) or namespace path (e.g., 'my-group/my-project'). URL-encoding is handled automatically.

issues.move.title: Move Issue
issues.move.description: Moves an issue from one project to another in GitLab. The issue receives a new IID and project_id in the destination project. Use this action when you need to relocate an issue to a different project, such as when reorganizing work or transferring issues between team projects. If equivalent labels or milestones exist in the destination project, they are automatically assigned to the moved issue.

projectId.description: The global ID or URL-encoded path of the source project (e.g., '12345', 'my-group/my-project').

issueIid.description: The internal ID of the project's issue to move.

toProjectId.description: The ID of the destination project where the issue will be moved.

jobs.play.title: Play Job
jobs.play.description: Triggers execution of a manual job in a GitLab project. Use this action when you need to start or run a job that requires manual intervention or has a manual status.

jobId.description: The ID of the job to play.

jobInputs.description: Custom job input values for the execution. This is a hash of key-value pairs.

projectId.description: The ID or URL-encoded path of the project.

jobVariablesAttributes.description: Custom variables as key-value pairs to pass to the job.

branches.protect.title: Protect Branch
branches.protect.description: Protects a repository branch in a GitLab project by setting access controls for push, merge, and unprotect operations. Use this action when you need to enforce branch protection rules to prevent unauthorized modifications or deletions of important branches like main, master, or release branches. Protected branches can restrict who can push, merge, force push, and remove protection.

name.description: The name of the branch or wildcard pattern to protect

projectId.description: The ID or URL-encoded path of the project

allowedToPush.description: Array of access levels allowed to push, with each described by a hash of user_id, group_id, deploy_key_id, or access_level (Premium/Ultimate only)

allowForcePush.description: When enabled, members who can push to this branch can also force push

allowedToMerge.description: Array of access levels allowed to merge, with each described by a hash of user_id, group_id, or access_level (Premium/Ultimate only)

pushAccessLevel.description: Default access level allowed to push. Valid values: 0 (No access), 30 (Developer), 40 (Maintainer, default), 60 (Admin)

mergeAccessLevel.description: Default access level allowed to merge. Valid values: 0 (No access), 30 (Developer), 40 (Maintainer, default), 60 (Admin)

allowedToUnprotect.description: Array of access levels allowed to unprotect, with each described by a hash of user_id, group_id, or access_level (Premium/Ultimate only)

unprotectAccessLevel.description: Default access level allowed to unprotect. Valid values: 30 (Developer), 40 (Maintainer, default), 60 (Admin)

codeOwnerApprovalRequired.description: Prevent pushes to this branch if it matches an item in the CODEOWNERS file (Premium and Ultimate only)

users.preferences.update.title: Update User Preferences
users.preferences.update.description: Tool to update the current user's preferences. Use when adjusting default diff viewing and CI identity settings.

viewDiffsFileByFile.description: Flag indicating the user sees only one file diff per page.

showWhitespaceInDiffs.description: Flag indicating the user sees whitespace changes in diffs.

passUserIdentitiesToCiJwt.description: Flag indicating the user passes their external identities as CI information. Internal use only; do not expose to third-party services.

issues.resetSpentTime.title: Reset Spent Time
issues.resetSpentTime.description: Resets the total spent time for a specified GitLab issue to 0 seconds. This action is irreversible — all previously recorded time entries will be cleared and cannot be recovered. Use this action when you need to clear all time tracking entries for an issue and start time tracking from scratch.

projectId.description: The global ID or URL-encoded path of the project (e.g., '12345', 'my-group/my-project', or 'my-group%2Fmy-project').

issueIid.description: The internal ID of the project's issue.

issues.resetTimeEstimate.title: Reset Time Estimate
issues.resetTimeEstimate.description: Resets the estimated time for a specified issue to 0 seconds. Use this action when you need to clear a previously set time estimate on an issue while preserving the total time spent.

projectId.description: The global ID or URL-encoded path of the project.

issueIid.description: The internal ID of the project's issue.

pipelines.retry.title: Retry Pipeline
pipelines.retry.description: Retries failed or canceled jobs in a pipeline. Use this action when you need to re-run a pipeline that has failed or was canceled. Note that if there are no failed or canceled jobs in the pipeline, calling this action has no effect.

projectId.description: The ID or URL-encoded path of the project.

pipelineId.description: The ID of the pipeline to retry.

issues.setTimeEstimate.title: Set Time Estimate
issues.setTimeEstimate.description: Sets the estimated time to complete an issue in a GitLab project. Use this action when you need to set or update the time estimate for tracking project work. The estimate is specified in human-readable format like '3h30m' for 3 hours and 30 minutes.

projectId.description: The global ID or URL-encoded path of the project.

duration.description: The time estimate in human-readable format (e.g., '3h30m', '2h', '45m'). Use 'h' for hours and 'm' for minutes.

issueIid.description: The internal ID of the project's issue.

users.status.set.title: Set User Status
users.status.set.description: Tool to set the current user's status. Use when you need to update availability or convey current mood on GitLab.

emoji.description: Name of the emoji to use as status. Defaults to 'speech_balloon' if omitted.

message.description: Status message to display. Max 100 characters; can contain emoji codes.

projects.share.title: Share Project With Group
projects.share.description: Tool to share a project with a group. Use when you need to grant a group specific access level to a project.

projectId.description: The ID or URL-encoded path of the project.

groupId.description: The ID of the group to share with.

expiresAt.description: Expiration date for the group share in YYYY-MM-DD format (ISO 8601).

groupAccess.description: The access level to grant the group. One of GitLab's access levels, e.g., 30 for Developer, 40 for Maintainer.

projects.star.title: Star Project
projects.star.description: Stars a project in GitLab, marking it as a favorite for the authenticated user. This adds the project to your starred projects list and increments its star count. Use this action when you want to bookmark or show support for a project. The operation is idempotent - starring an already-starred project succeeds without error.

projectId.description: The ID or URL-encoded path of the project to star.

projects.housekeeping.title: Start Housekeeping Task
projects.housekeeping.description: Tool to start the housekeeping task for a project. Use when you need to trigger manual maintenance or pruning on a repository.

projectId.description: The ID or URL-encoded path of the project.

mergeRequests.unapprove.title: Unapprove Merge Request
mergeRequests.unapprove.description: Removes the approval from the currently authenticated user for a specified merge request. Use this action when you need to revoke your previously given approval on a merge request. The action requires the merge request to have been previously approved by the authenticated user.

projectId.description: The ID or URL-encoded path of the project.

mergeRequestIid.description: Internal ID of the merge request.

branches.unprotect.title: Unprotect Branch
branches.unprotect.description: Tool to remove protection from a branch in a GitLab project. Use this action when you need to unprotect a branch, allowing unrestricted push and merge access. This action is irreversible in the sense that protection rules must be manually reapplied if needed later.

projectId.description: The ID or URL-encoded path of the project.

branchName.description: The name of the branch to unprotect, or a wildcard pattern.

projects.unstar.title: Unstar Project
projects.unstar.description: Unstar a previously starred GitLab project to remove it from your favorites list. Use this action when you need to remove a project from your starred projects. This action removes the star that was previously added by the authenticated user.

projectId.description: The ID or URL-encoded path of the project to unstar.

groups.update.title: Update GitLab Group
groups.update.description: Updates an existing GitLab group's settings and properties. Use this action when you need to modify group configuration such as name, path, visibility, permissions, or feature settings. Administrators can update additional settings like shared runners limits and IP restrictions.

groupId.description: The ID or URL-encoded path of the group.

lfsEnabled.description: Enable/disable Large File Storage (LFS) for the projects in this group.

defaultBranch.description: The default branch name for group's projects.

membershipLock.description: Users cannot be added to projects in this group. Premium and Ultimate only.

mentionsDisabled.description: Disable the capability of a group from getting mentioned.

autoDevopsEnabled.description: Default to Auto DevOps pipeline for all projects within this group.

ipRestrictionRanges.description: Comma-separated IP addresses or subnet masks to restrict group access. Premium and Ultimate only.

shareWithGroupLock.description: Prevent sharing a project with another group within this group.

requestAccessEnabled.description: Allow users to request member access.

twoFactorGracePeriod.description: Time before Two-factor authentication is enforced (in hours).

fileTemplateProjectId.description: The ID of the project for file templates. Premium and Ultimate only.

sharedRunnersMinutesLimit.description: Can be set by administrators only. Maximum number of monthly compute minutes for this group. Can be nil (default; inherit system default), 0 (unlimited), or > 0. GitLab Self-Managed, Premium and Ultimate only.

preventForkingOutsideGroup.description: Prevent project forking outside current group. Premium and Ultimate only.

uniqueProjectDownloadLimit.description: Maximum number of unique projects a user can download in the specified time period before they are banned. Premium and Ultimate only.

requireTwoFactorAuthentication.description: Require all users in this group to set up two-factor authentication.

extraSharedRunnersMinutesLimit.description: Can be set by administrators only. Additional compute minutes for this group. GitLab Self-Managed, Premium and Ultimate only.

autoBanUserOnExcessiveProjectsDownload.description: When enabled, users are automatically banned from the group when they download more than the maximum number of unique projects. Premium and Ultimate only.

issues.notes.update.title: Update Issue Note
issues.notes.update.description: Updates an existing note (comment) on a GitLab issue. Use this action when you need to edit the content of a previously created comment on an issue. This is useful for correcting typos, adding additional information, or updating outdated information in issue discussions.

projectId.description: The global ID or URL-encoded path of the project.
