body.description: The content of the note. Limited to 1,000,000 characters.

noteId.description: The ID of the note (comment) to update.

issueIid.description: The internal ID of the project's issue.

labels.update.title: Update Label
labels.update.description: Updates an existing label in a GitLab project by modifying its name, color, description, priority, or archived status. At least one of new_name or color must be provided to perform the update. Use this action when you need to rename a label, change its appearance, update its description, adjust its priority, or archive/unarchive it.

projectId.description: The ID or URL-encoded path of the project.

color.description: The new color for the label in 6-digit hex notation with leading '#' (e.g., #FFAABB) or CSS color name. Required if new_name is not provided.

archived.description: Set to true to mark the label as archived, false to unarchive. Defaults to false.

labelId.description: The ID or title of the label to update.

newName.description: The new name for the label. Required if color is not provided.

priority.description: The new priority for the label. Must be greater than or equal to 0, or set to null to remove priority.

description.description: The new description for the label.

milestones.update.title: Update Milestone
milestones.update.description: Updates an existing milestone in a GitLab project, allowing you to modify the title, description, dates, or state. Use this action when you need to change milestone details, adjust deadlines, or close/reopen a milestone.

projectId.description: The ID or URL-encoded path of the project.

title.description: The new title of the milestone.

dueDate.description: The new due date of the milestone in YYYY-MM-DD format.

startDate.description: The new start date of the milestone in YYYY-MM-DD format.

description.description: The new description of the milestone.

milestoneId.description: The ID of the project's milestone to update.

repository.files.update.title: Update Repository File
repository.files.update.description: Updates an existing file in a GitLab repository. Commits the changes to the specified branch with the provided commit message. Use this action when you need to modify file contents, change file permissions, or update files in a specific branch. Note that if concurrent modifications occur (detected via last_commit_id), the update will fail.

projectId.description: The ID or URL-encoded path of the project.

branch.description: Name of the branch to commit to. The commit is added to this branch.

content.description: The new content of the file.

filePath.description: URL-encoded full path to the file in the repository (e.g., lib%2Fclass%2Erb or path/to/file.txt).

authorName.description: The name of the commit author.

authorEmail.description: The email address of the commit author.

startBranch.description: Name of the branch to start the new commit from. If not provided, defaults to the value of branch.

lastCommitId.description: Last known file commit ID. Used to detect concurrent modifications.

executeFilemode.description: Enable or disable the execute flag on the file.

projectHooks.update.title: Update Webhook
projectHooks.update.description: Updates an existing project webhook configuration including URL, event triggers, SSL verification, and authentication token. Use this action when you need to modify a webhook's endpoint, change which events trigger notifications, update security settings, or rotate the authentication token. This operation is idempotent and overwrites the specified settings.

projectId.description: The ID or URL-encoded path of the project.

url.description: The webhook URL to which GitLab will send HTTP POST requests when events occur.

token.description: Secret token for authenticating webhook requests. GitLab includes this in the X-Gitlab-Token header.

hookId.description: The ID of the webhook to update.

wikiEvents.description: Trigger webhook on wiki page events.

issuesEvents.description: Trigger webhook on issue events (create, update, close).

tagPushEvents.description: Trigger webhook on tag push events.

mergeRequestsEvents.description: Trigger webhook on merge request events (create, update, merge, close).

enableSslVerification.description: Enable SSL certificate verification when delivering webhook payloads.

pushEventsBranchFilter.description: Filter push events by branch name (supports wildcards). Only triggers webhook for pushes to matching branches.

confidentialIssuesEvents.description: Trigger webhook on confidential issue events.
